title: Feed The Hungry Man, Or He KNOCKS 🍽️
premise: On a street of 43 pastel porches, every Friday at six each house leaves a plate out for the Hungry Man, who knocks all night at any door that forgets; one porch never leaves one, and last Friday, with Mom at work, I skipped ours.
twist: There is no Hungry Man: my mom made him up the first winter without Grandma so the street could feed Grandpa, who refused all help, and the tall man in the long coat who collects the plates and knocks to check on us is Grandpa himself.
world: A long street of small pastel houses with porches and warm porch lights at golden hour and at night, our cream house with a blue door across from Grandpa's gray-green one, and two small kitchens.
